issues.recommendation: Check the start pose and camera B's arm against the near bamboo (clear a culm from the first frame's line of sight, or start him a step on), and look at 16:9, 4:3 and phone portrait.
issues.target: bamboo start, first third-person frame and its photograph
issues.acceptance_condition: At a new commit, the first frame after 入山 and its photograph at 16:9, 4:3 and 9:16 have no culm crossing the novice or the stair's centre line.
issues.retest_note: 45d1c91: reproduced at 16:9, 4:3 and 9:16 (real P key, q=high, summer day); still open.

issues.finding: 同修留痕（#346）的 /api/trace 只按地点做全局令牌桶（burst 120、12/s、每日上限 25 万），不按来源限流：单个发送者可以抬高某地点当天的计数，或在桶空时让真实访客拿到 429。代码注释把按来源限流交给 Cloudflare 边缘规则（docs/RELEASING.md），本轮无 Cloudflare 权限，未能核实生产是否配置。数据本身不含个人信息。
issues.recommendation: 在生产 Worker 的路由上确认（或配置）/api/trace 的按来源限流规则，并在 docs/RELEASING.md 记下规则名与阈值；或在页面上把计数表述为近似值。
issues.target: worker/trace-core.js、生产 Cloudflare 路由 temple.rushiwowen.co/api/*
issues.acceptance_condition: 有生产边缘限流规则的配置记录（截图或 API 读回），且同一来源连发 200 次 /api/trace 后被边缘拦截，当日计数增量不超过规则阈值。

closed_earlier.finding: 石阶踢面与侧墙仍接近同材同明度，直缝使开场局部像现浇混凝土。
closed_earlier.recommendation: 区分踏面、踢面、挡墙石材尺度与收边，补挡墙压顶。
closed_earlier.acceptance_condition: 正常视角下每级踏面连续可读，挡墙不再与踢面并成同一砌体。
closed_earlier.retest_note: 727687e cam01/cam02: the tall side walls are replaced by low cheek stones (861874e); every tread reads continuously and the cheek no longer forms one masonry with the risers. The see-through gaps at the tread ends are tracked separately as STR-15.

closed_earlier.finding: e2e `camera` 仍断言拍照相机可被拖动转向，与已批准的'只远近、不转向'设计相反，使 `pnpm run verify` 在 9e78569 上为红。
closed_earlier.recommendation: 按设计改断言；之后在新提交上跑 camera 场景。
closed_earlier.acceptance_condition: 新提交上 camera 场景通过，且断言拍照模式下拖动不改变 yaw/pitch。
closed_earlier.retest_note: 727687e: camera scenario passed; it asserts that a drag does not change yaw/pitch with the photo camera raised.

closed_earlier.finding: 歇脚菜单英文在 1280×720 宽屏下时辰一行被裁（menu 场景首跑与单独重跑同一断言失败：{"fits":true,"clipped":true}）。开放 PR #180 写明由 #137 加「随时辰」引入、溢出 2 px；#179（f22b9ab）又改了菜单版面。
closed_earlier.recommendation: 合入一种修法后跑 menu/menufit 四语言三尺寸。
closed_earlier.acceptance_condition: 新提交上 menu 场景（或 menufit）四语言在 1280×720、1366×768、1920×1080 均 fits 且无 clipped。
closed_earlier.retest_note: 4aa2d5c: menu and menufit passed (zh/ja/en/ko × 1280×720, 1366×768, 1920×1080); fix commit not identified, closed on the new run.

closed_earlier.finding: 举相机时高档开着景深：__probe().post 报 dof:true、focus 6.18 m。yard.js 的 post.focus(Q.has("shot") || photo.on ? focusAt() : 0) 在 #125 重新加入了 8e4cb3f 已移除的拍照景深；docs/PHOTO-MODE.md 仍写「画面始终清晰……移除整个景深pass」。art-goal.md 第一阶段写「高档加很浅的景深，只在定机位和拍照时开」，与所有者确认的留影目标（LATEST-GOALS「不需要景深……远近景都清晰」）冲突。
closed_earlier.recommendation: 拍照时不开景深（photo.on 不再给焦距），或由所有者明确改留影目标；同时决定 ?shot 定机位是否保留，并修正 art-goal.md 与 PHOTO-MODE.md 其一。
closed_earlier.acceptance_condition: 同一锁定提交高档举相机时 __probe().post.dof 为 false，桌面成片近景与远山同样清晰；或有所有者改目标的记录。
closed_earlier.retest_note: b1ab530: real P key on q=high, post.dof stays false and focus 0; the raised frame is sharp near and far. Blur exists only as the player-chosen 虚化 switch (owner 2026-11-19).

regression_check.result: still closed: post.dof false walking and raised at three aspect ratios

publish.note: Routine status is synchronized by the site-status workflow from this file; the Site source was not changed.

limitations: SwiftShader only; no target-device performance and no GPU pictures at this commit.
Input is automated Playwright key events (keywalk, the P key); fixed views and keywalk's start are posed by the tool (diagnostic); no human recording, no five-zone normal-speed route.
Screenshots are on the HF evidence dataset (pinned at 0f4b10b); git keeps MANIFEST.json, logs and notes, no collage this round.
The ART-11 script failed once on its own 30 s screenshot timeout (log kept) and passed on one retry with 240 s.
Halls, loft, ending, doorways up close, the clip recording and sound not inspected.
Cloudflare edge configuration for /api/trace not readable from here.
